purpose: Give a fresh agent one compact map of the ASB Wayfinder harness, its entrypoints, validators, evidence surfaces, and known cross-shell traps.

structure.purpose: deterministic contracts, registries, runtime binding, schemas, fixtures, workflow specs, hooks, and report templates
PowerShell owning validators and completeness/runtime-binding checks
portable semantic and static contract validators

knownTraps: Installing jsonschema into one Python interpreter and then launching a nested PowerShell validator that resolves a different python from PATH.
Treating Windows short paths, junctions, redirects, or sys.executable normalization as interpreter failure merely because the requested and reported strings differ.
Relying on Markdown formatting literals in semantic assertions; normalize presentation syntax before asserting meaning.
Promoting hosted/static Wayfinder validation to live tracker or HITL proof.
Editing imported donor snapshots in place instead of refreshing the pinned source set through review.
proofCeiling: Repository structure, registered commands, interpreter-binding contract, static/hosted validators, and documented traps only; no live tracker/HITL or destination implementation proof.
